text.tspan: Kinase mean percentile shift: cluster − control
Points: kinases | dark: IQR | coral: mean
S2 | Kinase preferences and local co-occurrence sensitivity
A: Each ranked bar is a kinase mean shift over archived site pairs. B: All 309 kinases, grouped by family; counts are kinases, dark spans are interquartile
ranges and coral ticks are means. Vertical jitter only separates overlapping points. Single-kinase families have no distribution interval. Kinases share site
pairs; points are descriptive, not independent biological replicates. C: All 12 local co-occurrence estimates and their archived intervals; 11 include 1. No
